verdict.rationale: Ramp documents its own audit log: every write operation, including approvals and edits made via MCP/CLI, "lands in the customer's Ramp audit log automatically," with full attribution to the acting agent. Policy-grounded approval recommendations and auto-flagging of out-of-policy spend are also documented. However, the audit-log evidence is framed around agent actions rather than describing a per-expense history of edits, approvals and policy checks. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a per-expense audit trail covering all edits, approvals and policy-check outcomes; audit-log export or retention details; evidence of auditor-ready reporting or external-audit acceptance; independent corroboration.
